description.zh: 键盘优先的命令面板（command palette）。
description.en: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.

description.zh: DSH 回复中的文件路径可点击：Codex 风格行内打开、文件管理器定位、回合尾部文件 chip 列表。
description.en: Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.

description.zh: HUD 状态面板：Git 状态、MCP 服务器、技能列表、模型与 token 用量，悬浮侧栏一览无余。
description.en: HUD status panel: Git status, MCP servers, skills, model and token usage in a floating side panel.

description.zh: 拖放 fork：文档以可删除「文件芯片」挂在输入框上方，不打字也能发送。
description.en: File-drag fork: drop documents as removable chips above the composer, send without typing.

description.zh: 把鲸鱼娘思考时的 "deep diving" 状态文案自定义成任意你想要的样子。
description.en: Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.

description.zh: 右侧用户消息导航条，根据消息数量与可用高度自适应排布导航块，并支持悬停预览、键盘操作与点击跳转。
description.en: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.

description.zh: OpenCodeGo 剩余额度监视器：输入框右下角呼吸指示灯（按剩余额度绿/黄/红），液态玻璃面板显示滚动/周/月用量窗口与重置时间，每 30 秒自动刷新，API Key 自动读取 DSH 凭据。
description.en: OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI: a breathing indicator at the input's bottom-right (green/yellow/red by remaining share), a liquid-glass panel with rolling/weekly/monthly usage windows and reset times, auto-refreshing every 30 s; API key read from DSH credentials.

description.zh: DSH 文档阅读模式。
description.en: Document reading mode for DSH.

description.zh: 跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入，无需复制文件。
description.en: Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.

description.zh: 右侧面板展示 DeepSeek API 费用（当前会话 + 全部会话累计）与账户余额，内置官方计价与峰谷计价支持。
description.en: DeepSeek API spend (current session and all sessions) and account balance in the aside panel, with official pricing and peak/off-peak support.

description.zh: 人民币/美元 token 计费，官方政策计价与逐条消息费用账本。
description.en: RMB/USD token billing with official-policy pricing and a per-message cost ledger.

description.zh: 出租车计价器式实时计费：生成时逐秒跳动、空闲归零，内置官方峰谷时段与价格表。
description.en: Taxi-meter style real-time cost: ticks every half second while generating, resets when idle, with official peak/valley pricing built in.

description.zh: 隔离网页预览，通过元素批注指导源码修改。
description.en: Isolated web page previews with element annotations that guide source edits.

description.zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。
description.en: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.

description.zh: 侧边栏集成文件浏览器、终端和 Git 审查，方便预览文件。
description.en: Side panel with file browser, terminal, and Git review for quick file previews.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例的插件：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。
description.en: A multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.

description.zh: 「聚焦会话」精简视图，只关注最终产出结果。
description.en: A "focus chat" minimal view that shows only final outputs.

description.zh: Ctrl+V 粘贴文件 / 拖拽 / 选择。
description.en: Ctrl+V paste files / drag & drop / picker.

description.zh: 内嵌终端 dock + Git Review + 文件视图。
description.en: Embedded terminal dock + Git review + file view.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中展示 DeepSeek API 余额、余额趋势与每日用量图表。
description.en: DeepSeek API balance, balance trend, and daily usage charts in DSH Web settings.

description.zh: 输入框 dock 显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与会话花费，自动拉取官方定价，支持高峰/低谷计价。
description.en: DeepSeek account balance and session cost in the composer dock, with auto-fetched official pricing and peak/off-peak support.

description.zh: 右侧悬浮面板，环形图实时展示上下文 token 用量与费用。
description.en: Right-side floating panel with a live donut chart of context token usage and cost.

description.zh: 会话与当日 API 费用统计、预算图框（已用%）、官方余额、历史看板，支持峰谷计价与官方价格一键同步。
description.en: Per-session and daily API cost, budget with usage %, official balance, history dashboard, and one-click official price sync with peak/off-peak pricing.

description.zh: 一键收起会话中所有展开的区块（Think、工具卡等），常驻计数按钮 + 自定义快捷键。
description.en: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端 UI（TUI）。
description.en: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: Solarized 浅色主题、紧凑布局、思考/工具链折叠胶囊，以及余额、本轮成本与用量看板的 DSH Web 界面增强插件。
description.en: Solarized light theme, compact layout, think/tool-chain collapse capsules, and balance, session cost, and usage dashboards for the DSH web UI.

description.zh: 侧边栏底部 DeepSeek 账户余额显示与会话费用估算卡片。
description.en: DeepSeek account balance and per-session cost card in the sidebar foot.

description.zh: 从 Web 输入框上传任意本地文件，以待发送卡片展示，并在设置中管理已存文件。
description.en: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.

description.zh: 工程文件浏览器：会话视图文件页签，目录树 + VSCode 风格编辑器（C 语法高亮/行号/自动缩进/状态栏），跟随当前工作区。
description.en: Project file browser: per-session file tabs, a directory tree, and a VSCode-style editor (C syntax highlighting, line numbers, auto-indent, status bar) that follows the current workspace.

description.zh: Session log 按钮左侧的实时计费徽章：余额、每会话消耗、峰谷/平价价格，按模型/货币/思考强度自动切换，每天抓官方定价。
description.en: A real-time billing badge left of the Session log button: balance, per-conversation spend, peak/off-peak/flat pricing, auto-switching by model/currency/effort, daily official pricing fetch.

description.zh: DSH Web 聊天界面 GalGame 演出层：立绘差分、流式思考气泡、打字机对话框与 GalGame 式提问/审批选项框，可随时切回普通聊天。
description.en: A visual-novel presentation layer for the DSH Web chat view: portrait diffs, streaming thought bubble, typewriter dialogue, and GalGame-style question/approval panels; switch back to the normal chat anytime.

description.zh: 丝滑流式渲染：字跟着模型到达走、换行滑入、不闪，滚动归用户，尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
description.en: Silky streaming reveal for the Web UI: text appears at the model's arrival rate, new lines glide in, no flicker; follow stays with the user and `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected.

description.zh: PiUI 风格 diff 查看器，替换 write/edit 工具调用的默认 DiffBlock。
description.en: PiUI-style diff viewer replacing the stock DiffBlock for write/edit tool calls.

description.zh: 差分渲染 TUI 前端：流式 Markdown 与工具卡片。
description.en: Differential-rendering TUI front end with streaming markdown and tool cards.

description.zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。
description.en: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.

description.zh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。
description.en: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.

description.zh: 为 Web 设置页插件卡片补上中英文功能说明。
description.en: Bilingual descriptions on every plugin card in the Web Settings plugin list.

description.zh: 对话内生成式 UI：模型把交互式 HTML 卡片直接画进会话流，带流式预览与沙箱渲染。
description.en: In-conversation generative UI: the model renders interactive HTML cards into the chat stream, with streaming preview and sandboxed rendering.

description.zh: DSH Web 用量与费用统计插件：右下角悬浮窗，按模型/按天/按会话多维聚合与预计花费。
description.en: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.

description.zh: DSH 插件管理面板：一键启停 + 多源市场（GitHub/Gitee/自定义）+ 静态索引市场（500+ 插件 / 300 技能）+ 技能安装/停用 + 套装一键装配 + 框架升级适配。
description.en: DSH plugin manager panel: one-click enable/disable of installed plugins, multi-source market (GitHub/Gitee/custom), static-index market (500+ plugins / 300 skills), skill install/disable, one-click bundle assembly, and framework upgrade adaptation.

description.zh: 选中文字→批注→随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照。
description.en: Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.

description.zh: Codex 风格的 `@file` 文件引用，输入框里直接搜索并引用工作区文件。
description.en: Codex-style `@file` mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.

description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。
description.en: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.

description.zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。
description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.

description.zh: DSH 的设置扩展。
description.en: Settings extensions for DSH.

description.zh: Web Components 支持。
description.en: Web Components support.

description.zh: Rust/ratatui 终端客户端，直接使用 DSH SDK JSON-RPC 协议，支持独立运行或作为 profile bundle 加载。
description.en: A Rust/ratatui terminal client that speaks the DSH SDK JSON-RPC protocol directly and runs standalone or as a profile bundle.

description.zh: 网页输入区的终端式输入历史：方向键精确还原草稿/光标，Ctrl+R 反搜，工作区级回忆，感知滑动上下文。
description.en: Terminal-style input history for the Web composer: arrow keys restore drafts/cursor position exactly, Ctrl+R reverse search, workspace-scoped recall with sliding-context awareness.

description.zh: 运行时切换模型输出风格（对齐 Claude Code outputStyles），含 output.render.* 呈现协议与 /style 命令。
description.en: Runtime-switchable model output styles (aligned with Claude Code outputStyles), with the output.render.* presentation protocol and a /style command.

description.zh: 置顶会话与工作区到侧边栏：逐置顶行配色、看板/标签/已存视图、健康摘要与 /goto。
description.en: Pin sessions and workspaces to the sidebar: per-pin row colors, board/tag/saved views, health summaries, and /goto.

description.zh: 语音优先会话回路：输入区麦克风（浏览器/本地语音识别），speak 工具语音播报，事件播报与说话打断。
description.en: Voice-first conversation loop: a composer microphone (browser/local speech recognition), a speak tool for spoken replies, event announcements, and barge-in.

description.zh: 会话头部卡通用量小部件：布布玩偶 + 上下文占用/会话累计/构成，附日期周几、天气、3 天预报与极端天气预警（雨滴/雪花动画），跟随主题色。
description.en: Cute token-usage widget in the session header: a Bubu doll plus context occupancy, session usage and breakdown, with date/weekday, weather, 3-day forecast and severe-weather alerts (raindrop/snowflake animation), following the theme color.

description.zh: `?session=` / `?workspace=` 深链直达指定项目对话。
description.en: Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via `?session=` / `?workspace=`.

description.zh: 折叠对话中的 Think、Bash 等「无用消息」。
description.en: Collapse noisy messages (Think, Bash, etc.) in conversations.

description.zh: 在设置页展示 DeepSeek API 余额与最近 24 小时用量，包括估算消费、Token、请求次数和按小时时间线。
description.en: DeepSeek API balance and 24-hour usage dashboard in Settings, with estimated spend, token counts, request counts, and an hourly timeline.

description.zh: 轮次索引侧边栏，滚动时自动高亮当前轮次。
description.en: Turn-index sidebar with scroll-spy highlighting.

description.zh: 右侧圆点时间轴导航条，点击跳转到任意用户消息。
description.en: Right-side dot-timeline rail: jump between user messages.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加官方内置插件目录、搜索与状态说明，并提供经过审核的安全 UI 插件开关。
description.en: Adds a built-in plugin catalog to DSH Web with search, status explanations, and safe toggles for audited UI plugins.

description.zh: MCP 服务器与工具清单面板：侧边栏一键悬浮面板，按服务器分组展示全部 MCP 工具（传输方式、端点、JSON Schema、最近使用时间），默认折叠、支持搜索与实时刷新；最近使用时间来自真实会话日志。
description.en: MCP servers & tools inventory panel: one-click floating panel from the sidebar that lists every MCP server and tool (transport, endpoint, JSON schema, last-used time), grouped by server, collapsed by default, with live search and refresh; last-used times come from real session logs.

description.zh: Web UI 美元成本徽标：头部显示会话总成本、每条回复结尾显示该轮成本，悬停看分项。
description.en: Per-turn USD cost badge in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown.

description.zh: 在输入框上方 dock 显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（5h 滚动/每周/每月窗口与重置倒计时），内置凭据编辑器。
description.en: OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly windows with reset countdowns) in the composer dock, with a built-in credential editor.

description.zh: 对话轮次导航。
description.en: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.

description.zh: 对话节点导航条，右缘节点串快速跳转 user 消息。
description.en: Conversation node navigation bar for quick jumps between user messages.

description.zh: 后台任务状态条：对话页任务进度 + 实时输出 tail。
description.en: Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.

description.zh: 每条 AI 回复下方显示该轮真实花费：人民币、官方峰谷价、缓存读占比；纯本地读会话日志，零上报零密钥。
description.en: Per-turn real cost under every assistant reply: CNY at official peak/off-peak rates with cache-hit ratio; reads local session logs only, zero telemetry, zero keys.

description.zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。
description.en: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation.

description.zh: 任务摘要与上下文用量监控浮动面板（待办事项跟踪、文件与系统 Token 占用统计、8向缩放与快捷键）。
description.en: Task & Context Summary Floating Panel (todo tracking, file/system token breakdown, 8-way resize, shortcut).

description.zh: Web 外观主题定制（壁纸、毛玻璃、强调色、预设）、键盘快捷键、用量统计、插件市场、浮动历史条与用户消息 Markdown 渲染。
description.en: Web theming (wallpaper, glass, accent, presets), keyboard shortcuts, usage stats, a plugin marketplace, a floating history strip, and user-message Markdown rendering.

description.zh: 创意工坊式插件浏览器：一键安装/更新/卸载。
description.en: Steam Workshop-style in-app plugin browser with one-click install/update/uninstall.

description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：精灵图动画、agent 状态联动、拖拽、闹钟（每天/一次）与番茄钟，皮肤下拉选择 + 预览。
description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: sprite-sheet animation, agent state linkage, drag, alarm (daily/one-shot) and pomodoro widgets, skin picker with preview.

description.zh: 按中转站点、项目和模型统计本地 DSH Token 用量，并显示账户余额与订阅额度周期。
description.en: Shows local DSH token usage by relay site, project, and model, with account balances and subscription quota windows.

description.zh: 输入框麦克风：点击持续监控、按住对话；浏览器语音识别逐字上屏，回复由 host Edge TTS 边生成边朗读（句子切分），朗读时暂停识别防回声，点击可停止。
description.en: Composer microphone: click for continuous monitoring or hold to talk; browser speech recognition types words into the composer as you speak, while replies are read aloud as they stream via host Edge TTS (sentence-split), pausing recognition while reading to avoid echo, click to stop.

description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务看板、git 图、右侧面板、远程移动端 UI、桌宠、实时 token 统计与皮肤中心。
description.en: Plugin and skin collection for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center.

description.zh: OpenPencil 设计预览与编辑插件。
description.en: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin.

description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工作室：5 套内置预设 + 完全可自定义的浅/深配色（强调色、背景、前景、UI 与代码字体、半透明侧栏、对比度），即时热切换并持久化到 localStorage。
description.en: Theme studio for the DSH Web GUI: five built-in presets plus fully customizable light/dark palettes (accent, background, foreground, UI and code fonts, translucent sidebar, contrast), hot-swapped instantly and persisted in localStorage.

description.zh: DSH Web GUI 对话迷你地图（复刻 ChatGPT 桌面端）：每轮 Prompt 一个等距胶囊锚点，鱼眼钟形悬停放大 + 完整 Prompt 预览，顶部/底部渐隐，蓝色高亮跟随当前 Prompt，点击跳转对应消息，自动拉取完整历史。
description.en: A conversation minimap for the DSH Web GUI (ChatGPT desktop style): one evenly-spaced capsule anchor per user prompt, fish-eye bell-curve magnification on hover with full prompt preview, top/bottom edge fade, blue highlight that follows the current prompt, click to jump to the message, and automatic full-history loading.

description.zh: Web UI 皮肤。
description.en: Web UI skins.

description.zh: 32 款预设主题（莫兰迪 / 马卡龙 / 中国传统色）、动态与静态壁纸、纸纹纹理、分区透明度与文字深浅，附按键桌宠。
description.en: 32 preset themes across three palettes (Morandi, Macaron, Chinese traditional), animated and static wallpapers, paper textures, per-zone opacity and text depth, plus a keyboard desktop pet.

description.zh: DSH Web 自定义主题导入插件：支持本地路径/GitHub 集合一键导入、主题预览与实时刷新、托管主题库；格式轻量，作者可直接改 CSS/DOM 文件热加载，适合个人主题开发与分享。
description.en: DSH Web custom theme importer: one-click import from local paths or GitHub theme collections, live preview and refresh, hosted theme library; the lightweight format lets authors edit CSS/DOM files and hot-reload, making it a friendly option for personal theme development and sharing.

description.zh: Codex 风格皮肤切换器 + 自定义壁纸层，可调透明度与模糊。
description.en: Codex-style skin switcher plus a custom wallpaper layer with opacity and blur controls.

description.zh: 崩坏：星穹铁道「流萤」主题：立绘/动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、萤火氛围粒子、背景音乐、打字音效与按对话触发的表情包彩蛋。
description.en: A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme: wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.

description.zh: DSH 原神「奥黛塔」主题 UI 皮肤：深/浅双模式背景图 + 13 个主题 token 毛玻璃覆盖 + 侧栏 Q 版小兽皮肤开关，npm 即装即用。
description.en: A Genshin Impact "Odette" themed DSH UI skin: dark/light dual-mode background images, frosted-glass overrides for 13 theme tokens, and a chibi mascot sidebar toggle; install via npm.

description.zh: DSH 版 Claude Code /rewind：git 优先工作区快照 + 轮边界会话 fork + /checkpoint、/rewind 一键恢复。
description.en: Claude Code /rewind for DSH: git-first workspace snapshots plus per-turn session forks, with one-click restore via /checkpoint and /rewind.

description.zh: 四源迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、斜杠命令搬进 DSH 并可续跑。
description.en: Four-source migration wizard: move sessions, memory, skills, and slash commands from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Hermes into DSH and keep working.

description.zh: 会话跨设备同步：专用 git 镜像 + append-only 三方合并（keep-both + fork 冲突解决），/sync 命令与自动推拉。
description.en: Cross-device session sync: a dedicated git mirror with append-only three-way merging (keep-both + fork conflict resolution), a /sync command, and automatic push/pull.

description.zh: DSH Web 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊/渐变/URL）、每用户强调色、主题包导入导出与分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统。
description.en: One-command skinning for DSH Web: 8 original themes, wallpaper (opacity/blur/gradient/URL), per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export + favorites + surprise-me. Purely native on DSH's token system.

description.zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。
description.en: Whale-girl skin series for the DSH Web UI (maid-atelier).

description.zh: 15 个精选主题家族，浅深配色完整，跟随 DSH 原生浅色/深色/跟随系统模式。
description.en: Fifteen curated theme families with complete light and dark palettes that follow the native Light, Dark, and Follow system modes.

description.zh: 8 套精选配色方案与自定义调色板导入（名称+方案+种子色推导完整 token 映射），设置页「调色板」行，热插拔安装。
description.en: 8 curated color schemes plus custom palette import (name + scheme + seed colors derive a full token map), a Palette row in General settings, hot-plug install.

description.zh: 在设置界面新增「皮肤」页，自动发现已安装皮肤并一键切换，支持一键恢复官方默认外观。
description.en: Adds a Skins page to Settings that auto-discovers installed skins for one-click switching, with one-click restore to the official default look.

description.zh: 对话回退：基于持久 Change Ledger 回滚会话与工作区状态。
description.en: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.

description.zh: 分享任意段落的对话。
description.en: Share any excerpt of a conversation.

description.zh: `/side` 持续性侧会话与 `/btw` 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。
description.en: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.

description.zh: 会话历史消息查看：列出当前会话全部你发送的消息，支持排序、搜索、一键复制与点击跳转定位（目标未加载时自动加载更早历史）。
description.en: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and click-to-jump that auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded.

description.zh: 跨实例互联：经 interconnect 服务在多个 DSH 实例间转发消息与事件。
description.en: Cross-instance message and event handoff between DSH instances via an interconnect server.

description.zh: 让 dsh 和 Claude Code 会话直接互发消息，附带可点击的会话列表卡片（搜索/刷新/弹窗发送）。
description.en: Let dsh and Claude Code sessions message each other directly; comes with a clickable peer list card (sort/search/send/refresh).

description.zh: 跨 dsh/Codex/Claude Code/pi/OpenCode 会话只读搜索，无索引。
description.en: Index-free read-only search across dsh/Codex/Claude Code/pi/OpenCode sessions.

description.zh: 恢复已归档会话：/unarchive 命令与 unarchive_session 工具，把会话移出归档集合、在原位置重新出现在工作区（归档从不删除数据）。
description.en: Restore archived sessions: a /unarchive command and an unarchive_session tool that remove sessions from the archive set so they reappear in the workspace at their original position (archiving never deletes data).

description.zh: 轨迹解读标签页：按用户轮次解读助手做了什么（需求/思路/执行/结果），规则引擎 + 可选 LLM 叙述，文件/命令/错误一目了然，用户消息原样保留。
description.en: Trajectory interpretation tab: summarizes each user round — what was wanted and how the assistant fulfilled it (needs/thinking/execution/results) via a rules engine plus optional LLM narrative; files, commands and errors at a glance; user messages stay verbatim.

description.zh: 对话右缘消息轨道：每条用户消息一个品牌色圆点，悬停预览、点击跳转、自动加载未加载历史，纯插件零宿主侵入。
description.en: Message-index rail at the conversation's right edge: one brand-colored dot per user message, hover to preview, click to jump, auto-loads older history; pure plugin with no host patching.

description.zh: 一键分享你的对话。
description.en: Share your conversations with one click.

description.zh: 跨会话消息：本机任意会话都可像 Claude Code 一样列出并互发消息，基于本地心跳注册表与收件箱。
description.en: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.

description.zh: 双阶段会话标题生成：忙碌时即时关键词标题，空闲时由经济模型精修。
description.en: Two-phase session captioning: instant keyword captions while busy, budget-model refinement when idle.

description.zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。
description.en: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.

description.zh: 带实时预览的用户/内置 system prompt 分节编辑器。
description.en: Edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview.

description.zh: 把 Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor / Gemini / Reasonix / opencode 的聊天记录全保真导入为可续聊的 DSH 会话。
description.en: Import Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor / Gemini / Reasonix / opencode chat histories as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions.

description.zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。
description.en: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).

description.zh: DSH Web 用户消息气泡内联编辑与撤回：惰性提交、无痕替换、版本翻页器、草稿自动备份、三语 i18n。
description.en: In-bubble inline edit and recall for user messages in DSH Web: lazy commit, seamless replacement, a version pager, draft auto-backup, and trilingual i18n.

description.zh: 整会话改动审阅。会话顶栏列出本次 Agent 写过的每个文件与逐处改动，被权限拒绝的写入单独计数不算改动，数据来自 session projection。
description.en: Session-wide file change review. Lists every file the agent wrote this session with its hunks, counts refused writes separately from changes, and folds from a session projection.

description.zh: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。
description.en: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.

description.zh: 本地优先学习模式：跨会话全局学习线程、按来源讲解。
description.en: Local-first learning mode: cross-session learning threads with per-source explanations.

description.zh: 上下文洞察面板：一眼看清模型上下文窗口的组成与变化——构成对照窗口大小、按请求历史趋势、压缩/注入事件、消息级 token 统计。
description.en: Context insight panel: see what the model's context window is made of and how it evolves — composition vs. window size, per-request history, compression/injection events, and per-message token stats.

description.zh: 本地文献知识库 RAG：8 个工具（PDF/文件夹/Zotero 入库、BM25+向量+重排混合检索、DOI 可点击溯源问答、范围/严格模式、去重/清空/统计），全本地 bge 嵌入 + 单文件 SQLite，实测 242 篇 86s 入库、2 万块亚秒热查询。
description.en: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 8 tools (PDF/folder/Zotero ingest, hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, scope/strict modes, dedup/clear/stats), all-local bge embeddings + single-file SQLite, measured 242-doc/86s ingest and sub-second hot queries on 20k chunks.

description.zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。
description.en: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.

description.zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。
description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.

description.zh: 跨对话共享记忆：MEMORY.md + USER.md 注入每个会话系统提示词，memory 工具 + 可视化记忆面板，Hermes 式实现。
description.en: Cross-conversation shared memory: MEMORY.md + USER.md injected into every session's system prompt, with a memory tool and a GUI panel (Hermes-style).

description.zh: 文件型工作记忆：memorize/recall 把关键前提逐字保存在会话笔记文件，无损挺过上下文压缩。
description.en: File-backed working memory: memorize/recall key premises verbatim in a session notes file so they survive context compaction losslessly.

description.zh: 全局 Markdown 知识库桥：kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline 读写与 Codex kb.cmd CLI 共享的知识库（格式逐字节兼容）。
description.en: Bridge into a global Markdown knowledge base shared with the Codex kb.cmd CLI: kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline tools with byte-compatible frontmatter.

description.zh: 压缩后前提漂移守卫：摘要丢失关键字面锚点时注入一次性提醒。
description.en: Post-compaction premise-drift guard: injects a one-shot notice when a compaction summary drops a critical literal anchor.

description.zh: 基于 DSH 无损会话日志的引用式记忆：蒸馏出的事实带 `(sessionId, eventRange)` 引用，可随时展开回原始日志片段。
description.en: Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.

description.zh: 跨会话持久记忆插件：SQLite 本地存储 + 关键词/语义混合检索 + Web/MCP 界面，供编码代理存取经验与决策。
description.en: Cross-session persistent memory for coding agents: SQLite local storage, hybrid keyword/semantic retrieval, Web and MCP interfaces.

description.zh: 自动对话蒸馏：后台 subagent 反省 + 技能 create/update。
description.en: Automatic conversation distillation: background subagent reflection + skill create/update.

description.zh: 跨会话记忆：SQLite + 可人工编辑的 Markdown 镜像，后台自动巩固（去重/合并/冲突裁决），提供 6 个记忆工具。
description.en: Cross-session memory: SQLite with a human-editable Markdown mirror, background consolidation (dedup, merge, conflict resolution), and six memory tools.

description.zh: 给所有 AI 工具和 Agent 共用的一层记忆：注入 Context Bundle、提示时检索、MCP 工具与回合结束 DSH 线程捕获。
description.en: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.

description.zh: Mnemon 深度集成：本地三层记忆（Runtime Memory、可检索 Documents、受监督 Memory Spaces）。
description.en: Deep Mnemon integration: local three-tier memory (Runtime Memory, retrievable Documents, supervised Memory Spaces).

description.zh: 审批链上的第二模型自动审查：只读审查子代理返回带理由的 allow/deny 结构化裁决，fail-closed 兜底。
description.en: Second-model auto-review on the approval chain: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by default.

description.zh: 成本治理：按模型/会话/日聚合 token 与成本计量，预算上限 + 阈值告警 + alert/block/degrade 超限策略，/budget 命令。
description.en: Cost governance: token and cost metering aggregated by model/session/day, with budget caps, threshold alerts, and alert/block/degrade over-limit policies via the /budget command.

description.zh: 跨平台原生桌面控制（Windows 优先）：截图/读屏/点击/输入/滚轮/按键/应用启动，变更动作全过审批门。
description.en: Cross-platform native desktop control (Windows-first): screenshots, screen reading, click, input, scroll, keys, and app launching — every mutating action goes through an approval gate.

description.zh: 提示注入/越狱/密钥泄露检测：Aho-Corasick 引擎在用户消息、工具参数、工具结果三道缝上 allow/ask/block 拦截。
description.en: Prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak detection: an Aho-Corasick engine interposes allow/ask/block at three seams — user messages, tool arguments, and tool results.

description.zh: 统一静态图像生成路由：一个 image_generate 工具接 OpenAI 兼容引擎（OpenAI Images、智谱 CogView 等），健康感知回退 + 会话配额。
description.en: Unified static-image generation routing: one image_generate tool over OpenAI-compatible engines (OpenAI Images, Zhipu CogView, etc.) with health-aware fallback and per-session quotas.

description.zh: 本地文档知识库：语义+关键词混合检索、多样性重排、引用感知注入，SQLite 索引，零模型下载。
description.en: Local document knowledge base: hybrid semantic + keyword retrieval, diversity reranking, citation-aware injection, SQLite index, zero model downloads.

description.zh: PII 脱敏中间件：姓名/电话/身份证/银行卡等在到达模型前匿名化为占位符，展示层还原，绝不记录明文。
description.en: PII redaction middleware: names, phone numbers, ID cards, and bank cards are anonymized to placeholders before reaching the model and restored at the display layer; plaintext is never logged.

description.zh: 有界、分层、带审批门、可审计的跨会话记忆：`ctx.memory` 服务 + 零依赖 SQLite 存储 + `memory` 工具与冻结快照注入；写入必过审批门，模型可见内容可自会话日志重建。
description.en: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed `ctx.memory` seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a `memory` tool, and frozen snapshot injection; every write passes the approval gate and stays reconstructable from the session log.

description.zh: 声明式 allow/deny/ask 权限规则 + Codex 式进程级网络策略（内置本地 HTTP/CONNECT 代理），全量审计 + 规则热重载。
description.en: Declarative allow/deny/ask permission rules plus Codex-style per-process network policy (with a built-in local HTTP/CONNECT proxy), full audit logging and hot rule reload.

description.zh: 插件多维质量评分：安装成功/维护/文档/安全/协议合规五维，真实 CLI 证据 + 审计时间戳，产出 JSON/Markdown 榜单。
description.en: Multi-dimensional plugin quality scoring across five axes (install success, maintenance, docs, security, protocol compliance) with real CLI evidence, audit timestamps, and JSON/Markdown leaderboards.

description.zh: 插件隔离安装冒烟试驾：一次性 DSH_HOME profile 内安装+校验+启动，产出结构化通过/失败矩阵。
description.en: Isolated install-and-smoke-test for plugins: install, validate, and boot inside a throwaway DSH_HOME profile, producing a structured pass/fail matrix.

description.zh: 项目级跨会话记忆：PROJECT.md 快照注入首条用户消息（缓存友好）+ memory_remember 工具 + ReAct 任务结束自动反思；各项目独立记忆文件，互不互通。
description.en: Project-scoped cross-session memory: PROJECT.md snapshot injected into the first user message, a memory_remember tool, and auto-reflection after ReAct tasks; each project keeps its own memory file.

description.zh: 模型驱动的上下文压缩：由模型决定何时压缩、压缩什么。
description.en: Model-driven context compression: the model decides when and what to compress.

description.zh: 评分制记忆树插件 eco-memory-tree：结构化长期记忆，BM25/中文检索，Obsidian 双向同步。
description.en: A scored memory-tree plugin (eco-memory-tree): structured long-term memory with BM25/Chinese retrieval and two-way Obsidian sync.

description.zh: 动作-状态时序记忆：记录类型化的状态与动作，做趋势、异常与因果关联分析。
description.en: Action-state time memory: record typed states and actions, then analyze trends, anomalies, and causality.

description.zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。
description.en: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.

description.zh: 独立浏览器验收测试：JSON 清单驱动真实 Chromium，断言计算样式与像素差异，输出 HTML 报告 + 0/1 退出码；提供 npm CLI、GitHub Action 与 MCP Server。
description.en: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec drives real headless Chromium, asserts computed styles and pixel diffs, returns an HTML report and 0/1 exit code; ships npm CLI, GitHub Action, and MCP server.

description.zh: 文件增量挂载与重复读取去重：已挂载行范围不重复进上下文。
description.en: Incremental file mounting with read dedupe: mounted line ranges are never re-sent to the model.

description.zh: 纯文本模型识图桥接：通过任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API 提供 image_understand 工具（识图/OCR/UI 分析），支持允许目录白名单。
description.en: Vision bridge for text-only models: image_understand tool via any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API (OCR/UI analysis), with an allowed-directories whitelist.

description.zh: macOS 电脑控制：Accessibility 观测、过期状态拒绝、作用域权限与安全输入。
description.en: Accessibility-first macOS computer use: fresh observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.

description.zh: 让纯文本模型更好地做视觉任务：带意图的图片问答、长截图 OCR、UI 还原等。
description.en: Vision tasks for text-only models: intent-aware image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI reproduction, grounding, and pixel diff.

description.zh: 香港保险数据 MCP：260+ 真实产品、17 家保司、分红实现率，供 Hermes / dsh / Claude Code 等 AI 工具查询/对比/测算。
description.en: Hong Kong insurance data MCP: 260+ real products, 17 insurers, dividend fulfillment rates. Query/compare/calculate for any AI tool (Hermes / dsh / Claude Code).

description.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。
description.en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.

description.zh: 将 @firecrawl/anydoc 作为 anydoc 工具注册给 Agent，把 Word/PPT/Excel/PDF/EPUB 等多种文档格式转换为 GitHub-Flavored Markdown。
description.en: Registers @firecrawl/anydoc as an `anydoc` tool for the Agent, converting Word/PPT/Excel/PDF/EPUB and other document formats into GitHub-Flavored Markdown.

description.zh: RSS 新闻采集工具，抓取 10+ 中英文源为结构化条目。
description.en: RSS news fetch tool that grabs 10+ CN/EN feeds into structured items.

description.zh: 统一 LLM 请求/响应检查器：调 reasoning effort、外部思考(think)导出、流量与包分析。
description.en: Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.

description.zh: 费曼学习法教学闭环，渲染为富 HTML 教学卡片。
description.en: Feynman learning-mode loop rendered as rich HTML lesson cards.

description.zh: MCP server 让任意 MCP 客户端驱动 Harness agent。
description.en: MCP server that lets any MCP client drive the Harness agent.

description.zh: 把 DSH 会话一键变成日报/周报/交接文档/文章，附可验证凭据。
description.en: Turn a DSH session into daily/weekly/handoff/article reports with verifiable receipts.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中创建、编辑、检查和交付表格、文档、演示文稿、多维表格和画布，支持实时预览与 worktree 审阅。
description.en: Create, edit, inspect, and deliver spreadsheets, documents, presentations, databases, and canvases in DeepSeek Harness, with live preview and worktree review.

description.zh: Browser4 AI-native 浏览器引擎（skills）。
description.en: Browser4 AI-native browser engine exposed as skills.

description.zh: WebUI 内嵌有头浏览器，模型实时操控、0 视觉依赖。
description.en: Headed browser embedded in the WebUI, model-driven and zero vision deps.

description.zh: 模型读写 Office 文件，web 客户端 docx/pdf 预览。
description.en: Model reads/edits Office files with docx/pdf preview in the web client.

description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件市场：设置页内逛/搜全部社区插件，按分类筛选，确认后一键安装，已装插件一目了然。
description.en: The plugin market inside DSH: a Settings page to browse and search the full community catalog by category, with confirmed one-click installs and an installed-plugins view.

description.zh: 按需取回薄层：context_query / context_slice / context_grep 三个工具读取已持久化的历史，引用可回放。
description.en: Thin on-demand context retrieval: context_query / context_slice / context_grep tools that read already-persisted history back with replay-safe citations.

description.zh: 远程工作区：SSH 密码或 key 连接远程主机，选取远程工作区目录，用 rw_pick_workspace / rw_list_dir / rw_read_file / rw_exec 工具在远程直接操作。
description.en: Remote workspace: connect a host over SSH (password or key), pick a remote workspace directory and operate on it with rw_pick_workspace / rw_list_dir / rw_read_file / rw_exec tools.

description.zh: 点击消息里的 Windows 绝对路径在资源管理器中打开所在文件夹（文件定位选中/目录直接打开）。
description.en: Click any absolute Windows path in DSH messages to reveal it in Explorer (select the file or open the folder).

description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先视觉：由本地 VLM（LM Studio / Ollama / vLLM）产出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR / 版面 / 语义），零 API 成本，图片数据完全不出本机。
description.en: Local-first vision for the text-only DeepSeek Harness: a local VLM (LM Studio / Ollama / vLLM) produces structured JSON evidence (OCR / layout / semantics) at zero API cost, with image data never leaving the machine.

description.zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出技能插件、MCP 服务器与卫生文件的安装建议（claude-code-setup 的 DSH 对应）。
description.en: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db hints and recommends skill plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files (claude-code-setup counterpart).

description.zh: DSH 的 net-access 权限模式：文件写保护不变，沙箱内 curl.exe 可用 HTTPS（Windows）。
description.en: Net Access permission mode: keeps workspace-write protection while making curl.exe HTTPS work inside the sandbox (Windows).

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里对话完成 Excel 工作：建表、编辑、修复公式、图表校验，每次编辑后自动体检公式。
description.en: Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, repair, and verify spreadsheets by conversation, with automatic formula health checks after every edit.

description.zh: 向模型暴露 MineRU 文档解析工具。
description.en: Expose MineRU document parsing tools to the model.

description.zh: 浏览器自动化（Playwright，带实时画面）+ MCP Server（把 DSH agent 暴露给任何 MCP 客户端）+ GitHub issue/PR/webhook 评审工具。
description.en: Browser automation (Playwright) with a live view, an MCP server exposing DSH agents to any MCP client, and GitHub issue/PR/webhook review tools.

description.zh: 将官方 pen.dev Pencil 设计能力接入 DeepSeek Harness：桥接官方 CLI，Agent 可在会话中编辑 .pen 文件，并针对 DeepSeek 纯文本模型做了专门优化。
description.en: Bring the official pen.dev Pencil into DeepSeek Harness via the official CLI: in-conversation .pen editing tools, optimized specifically for DeepSeek's text-only model.

description.zh: doc_read/doc_write：以有界、单元格寻址的方式读写 xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb，另附 MCP 服务器与 CLI。
description.en: Bounded, cell-addressed `doc_read`/`doc_write` for xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb, plus an MCP server and CLI.

description.zh: 类型安全、带护栏的容器控制：ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop 与 compose up/down，JSON 输出、项目感知定位、破坏性操作需审批。
description.en: Typed, guarded container control: ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop and compose up/down with JSON output, project-aware targeting, and approval-gated destructive ops.

description.zh: 把已有的 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）技能库带进 DSH：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录、注入渐进式索引，按需加载技能正文。
description.en: Bring your existing Agent Skills (SKILL.md) library to DSH: discover skills across Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini paths, inject a progressive-disclosure index, and load bodies on demand.

description.zh: 语音输入、语音输出：把口述音频转写为用户消息（transcribe），让 agent 朗读回复（speak），本地优先，音频存于 ~/.dsh/voice。
description.en: Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.

description.zh: DSH 的 Xcode AI 集成：26 个 Xcode MCP 工具（mcpbridge）+ Apple 平台技能 + Xcode Intelligence 风格 persona（agent preset 或全局 bundle）。
description.en: Xcode AI integration for DSH: 26 Xcode MCP tools (mcpbridge) + Apple platform skills + Xcode Intelligence-style persona (agent preset or global bundle).

description.zh: gavel-review：对抗式多视角代码审查——并行攻击视角、确定性静态哨兵、严重度定级与审查历史。
description.en: gavel-review: adversarial multi-perspective code review — parallel attack lenses, static sentinels, severity grading.

description.zh: Web Bridge：面向 dsh 的浏览器自动化 MCP 服务器——真实浏览器导航、点击、填表、截图、JS 执行，无障碍快照驱动。
description.en: Web Bridge: real-browser automation MCP server — navigation, click, form-fill, screenshots, JS execution, accessibility-snapshot driven.

description.zh: 代码知识图谱：把符号、调用点与导入索引进 SQLite，回答调用/依赖问题。
description.en: Code knowledge graph: indexes symbols, call sites and imports into SQLite, answers call/dependency questions.

description.zh: 扫描项目声明的构建命令（Makefile、package.json scripts、justfile、deno tasks）并作为 agent 工具暴露。
description.en: Scans declared project build commands (Makefile, package.json scripts, justfile, deno tasks) and exposes them as agent tools.

description.zh: 桌面控制：屏幕捕获、指针/键盘注入、无障碍树操作、确认流程与紧急停止。
description.en: Desktop control: screen capture, pointer/keyboard injection, accessibility-tree actions, confirmation flow, emergency stop.

description.zh: 会话上下文整理插件：修剪过期、重复、失败与过大的上下文以节省 token 预算。
description.en: Session context triage: prunes stale, repeated, failed and oversized context to save token budget.

description.zh: doctrove：版本化库文档检索 MCP 服务器，零运行时依赖，可作 dsh 插件 bundle 安装。
description.en: doctrove: versioned library documentation retrieval MCP server, zero runtime dependencies.

description.zh: paddock：受限本地文件系统 MCP 服务器——文件访问限定在可配置区域，零运行时依赖。
description.en: paddock: constrained local filesystem MCP server — file access confined to configurable zones, zero runtime dependencies.

description.zh: repogate：GitHub 开发者工作台 MCP 服务器——仓库、issue、PR、代码审查、搜索，零运行时依赖。
description.en: repogate: GitHub developer workbench MCP server — repos, issues, PRs, code review, search, zero runtime dependencies.

description.zh: 后台终端（PTY）任务管理：启动长时进程、喂入输入、翻页输出、按需停止。
description.en: Background terminal (PTY) job management: launch long-running processes, feed input, page output, stop on demand.

description.zh: 编码 agent 破坏性命令拦截闸门：rm -rf / git reset --hard / push --force 执行前解析判定并要求人工确认（dsh 插件 + 通用 CLI）。
description.en: Destructive-command interception gate: parses and requires human approval for rm -rf / git reset --hard / push --force before execution (dsh plugin + standalone CLI).

description.zh: 阻止 agent 读写敏感文件（.env、凭据），掩码工具结果中泄露的密钥，附审计日志与安全的 sg_* 检查工具。
description.en: Blocks agents from reading/writing sensitive files, masks leaked secrets in tool results, with an audit journal and safe sg_* inspection tools.

description.zh: Steno：发送前的行内 #tag 快捷展开——多库、别名、{{变量}}、递归防护。
description.en: Steno: inline #tag shorthand expansion before send — multi-library, aliases, {{variables}}, recursion guards.

description.zh: 实时终端状态行：一行展示模型、上下文占用、子代理、速率限制与会话时长。
description.en: Real-time terminal statusline: model, context usage, sub-agents, rate limits and session time in one line.

description.zh: 任务隔离的 git 工作区：按任务自动创建、同步与收尾隔离工作区。
description.en: Task-isolated git worktrees: auto-create, sync and tear down isolated workspaces per task.

description.zh: token 优化插件：屏蔽低信号读取、压缩大输出、哈希去重、smart_read 骨架化（tree-sitter）、BM25 检索，真实用量统计 + 持久化；入历史前削减，不破坏缓存命中。
description.en: Token optimizer for DSH: blocks low-signal reads, compresses oversized outputs, hash-dedupes repeated calls, smart_read skeletonization (tree-sitter), BM25 retrieval; real usage metering + persistence. Pre-history pruning keeps prompt-cache hits.

description.zh: Android GUI Agent：ADB 截图、压缩 UI hierarchy 定位、逐步动作验证、审批和 Mobile Web 视图。
description.en: Android GUI Agent with ADB screenshots, compact UI hierarchy grounding, verified iterative actions, approvals, and a Mobile Web view.

description.zh: 桌面与网页自动化：📸 多屏截图 + 🔍 Windows OCR（文字+像素坐标）+ 🖱️ 鼠标点击/拖拽 + ⌨️ 中文打字/按键 + 🪟 窗口激活，含实战打磨的画图能力（鼠标加速度补偿、画布定位、贝塞尔曲线，可在画图中绘制图形）。
description.en: Desktop and web automation: 📸 multi-screen screenshots, 🔍 Windows OCR (text + pixel coordinates), 🖱️ mouse click/drag, ⌨️ Chinese typing/keys, and 🪟 window activation, with battle-tested drawing in Paint (mouse acceleration compensation, canvas positioning, Bézier curves).

description.zh: 语音对话：🎤 语音输入（Web Speech，实时中间结果可编辑）+ 🔊 自动/手动朗读回复（TTS），支持人声/语速/语调设置与识别语言（普通话/粤语等），纯客户端零密钥，朗读前自动清理 Markdown 标记。
description.en: Voice chat: 🎤 speech input (Web Speech, live editable interim results) plus 🔊 automatic/manual read-aloud replies (TTS), with voice, speed, pitch and recognition-language settings (Mandarin/Cantonese, etc.); fully client-side with zero keys, and Markdown is stripped before reading.

description.zh: 完整的任务级 git worktree：per-repo manifest 永久保存、worktree-<name> 分支、主目录带回（bring-back）与直接提交两种收尾、可携带主工作区未提交改动（参考 Qoder / Codex / Claude Code）。
description.en: Complete task-scoped git worktrees: per-repo manifest for durable state, worktree-<name> branches, bring-back to main or direct commit, optional carry-over of uncommitted main changes (modeled on Qoder / Codex / Claude Code).

description.zh: DSH 撤销/回退系统：配置变更自动存档，一键撤销/恢复/回退到任意版本，支持 WebUI 与离线 CLI/GUI 工具（DSH 启动失败也能救）。
description.en: Undo/redo & rollback system for DSH: every config change is auto-snapshotted; undo/redo/restore to any version from the WebUI or the offline CLI/GUI tools (works even when DSH fails to boot).

description.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。
description.en: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).

description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥：搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。
description.en: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).

description.zh: 用 Tree-sitter 建立工作区符号索引，提供词法或可选 embedding 辅助的代码检索。
description.en: Indexes workspace symbols with Tree-sitter and provides lexical or optional embedding-assisted code search.

description.zh: 让 dsh 通过 grok2api 的 API 获得生成图片与视频能力。
description.en: Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.

description.zh: 基于代码库知识图谱的 read_graph 工具（CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL 关系）。
description.en: A read_graph tool backed by a codebase knowledge graph (CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL relations).

description.zh: Chrome 侧边栏扩展，让 DSH 直接操控你的浏览器，无需视觉能力。
description.en: Chrome sidebar extension that lets DSH operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required.

description.zh: 结构化 Git 工具（status/diff/log/branch/stage/commit）+ 破坏性命令安全护栏。
description.en: Structured Git tools (status/diff/log/branch/stage/commit) with a destructive-command guard.

description.zh: 在 dsh-subagent-tools 基础上增加子代理按调用 cwd，附带所需的两个 in-process provider 补丁。
description.en: Extends dsh-subagent-tools with a per-call cwd for subagents, shipped with the two in-process provider patches it requires.

description.zh: 子代理委派的按调用覆盖：model/provider/persona/toolFilter、@preset: 引用与 provider/model 组合 id。
description.en: Per-call model, provider, persona, and toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, with @preset: references and provider/model composite ids.

description.zh: 学术助手插件。
description.en: Academic assistant plugin.

description.zh: 只读交易研究工作台：类型化行情数据接缝（可自带数据源）、多周期指标 regime 快照、dsh web 交互式 K 线卡（AI 标注需引用依据并经真实 K 线区间校验）、结构性禁止下单的 risk-guard。
description.en: Read-only trading research workbench: a typed market-data seam (bring your own data source), multi-timeframe indicator regime snapshots, interactive candlestick cards in the dsh web UI (AI annotations require cited sources verified against real candle ranges), and a structurally order-blocking risk-guard.

description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。
description.en: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.

description.zh: 自动审批门控：Flash 预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全操作自动批准、危险操作转人工（fail-safe）。
description.en: Risk-gated approval automation: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe).

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图。
description.en: Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a `vision_understand` tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus paste/drag-and-drop/button entry points for image recognition.

description.zh: 用 Monaco 编辑器创建和管理沙箱化的自定义 JavaScript 工具。
description.en: Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools with a Monaco editor.

description.zh: 让 AI 帮你连数据库、写 SQL。
description.en: Let the AI connect to databases and write SQL for you.

description.zh: 从 md/txt/docx/pdf 构建可审计知识库包（SQLite FTS5），确定性检索与原文阅读。
description.en: Build auditable KB packs (SQLite FTS5) from md/txt/docx/pdf with deterministic retrieval and original-text reading.

description.zh: 安全的数学表达式求值器，零依赖递归下降解析器。
description.en: Safe math expression evaluator, zero-dependency recursive-descent parser.

description.zh: CSV 解析/查询/统计/转换（RFC 4180），零依赖状态机解析器。
description.en: Parse/query/aggregate/convert CSV (RFC 4180) with a zero-dependency state-machine parser.

description.zh: 文本/JSON/CSV/Markdown 结构化比较与 unified diff。
description.en: Structured comparison and unified diffs for text/JSON/CSV/Markdown.

description.zh: base64/url/hex 编解码、常用哈希、UUID 生成。
description.en: base64/url/hex encoding, common hashes, and UUID generation.

description.zh: JMESPath 子集 JSON 查询。
description.en: JSON queries with a JMESPath subset.

description.zh: HTML↔Markdown 转换、GFM 表格规范化、目录生成。
description.en: HTML↔Markdown conversion, GFM table normalization, and TOC generation.

description.zh: 正则测试/提取/安全替换/静态解释（不执行代码）。
description.en: Test/extract/safe-replace/statically explain regexes without executing code.

description.zh: JSON Schema 验证：validate/paths/explain/normalize。
description.en: JSON Schema validation: validate/paths/explain/normalize.

description.zh: 描述统计/百分位数/频数分布/相关性。
description.en: Descriptive statistics, percentiles, frequency distributions, and correlation.

description.zh: 严格 ISO 8601 解析、IANA 时区转换、UTC 日历运算。
description.en: Strict ISO 8601 parsing, IANA timezone conversion, and UTC calendar arithmetic.

description.zh: 零依赖工具包：time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema 十件套一键安装。
description.en: Zero-dependency toolkit: time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema — ten deterministic tools in one install.

description.zh: 可续跑的后台子代理 + 持久多代理团队房间：消息总线、共享任务板、审批门交接，跨重启存活。
description.en: Resumable background subagents plus persistent multi-agent team rooms: a message bus, shared task boards, and approval-gated handoffs that survive restarts.

description.zh: 插件开发知识库打包为按需加载的 agent 技能：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑。
description.en: A plugin-development knowledge base packaged as on-demand agent skills: official constraints, task workflows, API references, and community gotchas.

description.zh: 安全审计技能包 + plugin_vet 供应链门禁：八个双语技能 + 自动化预安装扫描器。
description.en: Security-audit skill pack plus a plugin_vet supply-chain gate: eight bilingual skills and an automated pre-install scanner.

description.zh: 基于 Manim CE 的数学动画插件：6 个内置模板（函数/导数/积分/几何/极坐标/3D 曲面）+ 零代码技能包（math-animation / manim-codegen），模型说人话即可生成动画视频，含 AST 静态安全校验。
description.en: Manim CE based math animation plugin: 6 built-in templates (function/derivative/integral/geometry/polar/3D surface) plus a zero-code skill pack (math-animation / manim-codegen) - natural language to animated math videos, with AST static security validation.

description.zh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。
description.en: Upload local images and files to your image host through PicGo's existing configuration (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, COS, Qiniu, or any installed uploader plugin), via a `picgo_upload` tool and a `/picgo` command.

description.zh: 豆包音质对话内朗读：每条 AI 回复 🔊 点读/自动朗读（默认关、状态持久化），音色由本地 Omi 引擎合成（豆包 seed-tts），BYOK（Key 只留在本机 Keychain，插件零 Key）。
description.en: In-conversation read-aloud with Doubao-quality voices: every AI reply gets a 🔊 tap-to-read / auto-read toggle (off by default, state persisted), with voices synthesized by the local Omi engine (Doubao seed-tts); BYOK — keys stay in your local Keychain, the plugin stores none.

description.zh: 把 .pack.json/.pack.zip 投影到 .agent-pack/modpacks/，按工作区白名单暴露 skill。
description.en: Project .pack.json/.pack.zip into .agent-pack/modpacks/ and expose skills via a workspace allow-list.

description.zh: ADB 设备·台架运维工具集：设备发现、结构化 logcat（后台采集）、apk 安装、文件 pull/push、性能快照。
description.en: ADB device & bench operations for DSH: device discovery, structured logcat (background streaming), apk install, file pull/push, and dumpsys performance snapshots.

description.zh: dsh Web GUI 内的社区插件市场：浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 目录，从 设置 → 插件 → 插件市场 安装/卸载插件到 profile。
description.en: In-harness plugin market for the dsh web GUI: browse the awesome-dsh-plugin.com catalog and install/uninstall plugins into a profile from Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market.

description.zh: 小说写作助手：章节库管理、句式模式分析（九类句式/情感曲线/风格指纹）、风格自检、伏笔登记、批量导入与续写辅助，带 Web UI 开关。
description.en: Novel writing assistant: chapter library, sentence-pattern analysis (9 categories / emotion curve / style fingerprint), style check, plot tracking, batch import and continuation writing, with per-tool Web UI toggles.

description.zh: 专为 agent 打造的搜索工具：多语言，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。
description.en: Search built for agents: multilingual coverage across web, academic, code, shopping, finance, news, and encyclopedias.

description.zh: OpenMAIC 教学：课堂、幻灯片、交互组件与苏格拉底式教学。
description.en: OpenMAIC: classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching.

description.zh: ctx.web 接缝的零配置 Exa 网页搜索提供方：无 API key 时走匿名 MCP 兜底，配 key 时走 REST 搜索。
description.en: Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.

description.zh: 按 agent 的按需工具发现与渐进式 schema 披露。
description.en: Per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure.

description.zh: 一键备份 DSH 用户数据：/backup 命令、定时自动备份、sha256 校验与自动轮换。
description.en: One-command backup of DSH user data: /backup, scheduled auto-backup, sha256 checksums and rotation.

description.zh: Coding Coach 编程教练：面向非开发人员的 35 技能 bundle + 完整 Agent 预设（八段编排流水线 + 工程/产品/界面技能），npm 可装 `dsh plugin add coding-coach`，同时提供 Claude Code 插件。
description.en: Coding Coach: a 35-skill bundle plus a full agent preset for non-developers (8-stage product→launch pipeline with engineering/product/UI skills), installable via npm (`dsh plugin add coding-coach`) and as a Claude Code plugin.

description.zh: DeepRead 精读助手：五种精读模式（quick / deep / map 知识地图（四档置信度）/ feynman 费曼读书法 / book 全书）、批量对比、预算预检与后台任务进度透明、微信公众号链接 / .pdf 文件（内置纯 JS 提取器）/ 粘贴文本，可选导出 MD / FreeMind 思维导图（XMind 可导入）/ 编辑风网页报告。
description.en: DeepRead: deep-reading assistant with five modes (quick / deep / knowledge map with four confidence levels / Feynman reading / whole book), batch comparison, budget preflight, and transparent background-job progress, from WeChat article links / local .pdf (built-in pure-JS extractor) / pasted text, with optional MD / FreeMind / styled HTML export.

description.zh: 论文写作守卫：本地规则扫描修改过程残留、防御性写作与 AI 写作痕迹（破折号滥用、不是X而是Y、LLM 高频词、三连排比），论文文件写入后增量自动审计（writing_audit / writing_rules）。
description.en: Academic writing guard: local-regex linter for revision-process residue, defensive writing and AI-writing tells (em-dash abuse, not-X-but-Y, LLM word spikes, rule of three), with incremental auto-audit on paper file writes (writing_audit + writing_rules).

description.zh: 反爬 HTTP 工具：UA 池轮换、指数退避重试、反爬墙检测（验证码/安全验证）与自适应限流，提炼自 SXS 生产采集体系（每日数百万请求）——工具：`sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`。
description.en: Anti-bot HTTP fetch tools hardened by SXS's production scraping stack (millions of requests/day): UA-pool rotation, retry with exponential backoff, anti-bot wall detection (captcha / verification challenges) and adaptive rate limiting — tools: `sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`.

description.zh: 时事热点采集：一次调用聚合百度热搜 / 头条热榜 / 抖音热点 / 微博热搜（微博可选 cookie），返回标题+热度值，供内容创作借势——工具：`sxs_news_hot`。
description.en: Trending-topics collector aggregating Baidu / Toutiao / Douyin / Weibo hot lists in one call (Weibo optional cookie), returning titles with heat values for content creators — tool: `sxs_news_hot`.

description.zh: 文本卫生 dsh 插件：净化不可信文本、扫描隐形字符、清洗 LLM 格式、转义 CSV 公式注入。
description.en: Text hygiene as a dsh plugin: sanitize untrusted text, scan invisible characters, clean LLM formatting, and escape CSV formula injection.

description.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免 Key 视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（看图问答、定位、裁剪、像素对比、取色、OCR、矢量化、抠图、截图）；粘贴图片即可用。
description.en: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.

description.zh: 将 DSH 对话导出为锤子便签风格 PNG，或在配置的账号工作区中新建和更新 Markdown 便签。
description.en: Export DSH conversations as Smartisan Notes-style PNGs, or create and update Markdown notes in a configured account-scoped workspace.

description.zh: ADHD 行为辅导技能：任务拆解、事项过载管理、启动仪式与失败重启。
description.en: ADHD behavioral coaching skill: task breakdown, overwhelm management, launch rituals, and failure recovery.

description.zh: 查询 64 场中国考试（高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…）的规则日期（第二个周六、第一个周日）与倒计时。
description.en: Query 64 Chinese exams (高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…) with rule-aware date math (2nd-Saturday, 1st-Sunday) and countdowns.

description.zh: 将 SVG 路径与关键帧参数编译成自包含的 Lottie JSON 动画文件。
description.en: Compile SVG paths and keyframe specs into self-contained Lottie JSON animation files.

description.zh: 多引擎反向识图聚合：Google Lens、百度、Yandex、TinEye、SauceNAO、IQDB、Ascii2d。
description.en: Multi-engine reverse image search aggregator: Google Lens, Baidu, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB, Ascii2d.

description.zh: 检测并下载 B站/YouTube/抖音/小红书视频媒体，带清晰度与格式分析。
description.en: Detect and download media from Bilibili/YouTube/Douyin/Xiaohongshu with quality and format analysis.

description.zh: 基于纯日期数学的周期习惯排程：下次发生日、区间排程与逾期提醒。
description.en: Recurring-habit scheduling from pure date math: next occurrence, range schedules, and overdue advice.

description.zh: 持续自进化：从会话轨迹沉淀版本化、可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态（提示词/记忆/技能/子代理规格），带审查门禁与技能热加载。
description.en: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.

description.zh: DSH 插件透明排行与推荐：每日自动抓取 `dsh-plugin` 话题生态，公开评分模型，提供 rank/search/recommend 工具与设置页榜单。
description.en: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.

description.zh: Creght 平台建站技能包：CLI 拉取/推送同步、页面与组件规范、CMS、表单、Auth、SEO、发布与版本回滚。
description.en: Skills for building websites on the Creght platform: CLI pull/push sync, page and component conventions, CMS, forms, auth, SEO, publishing and version rollback.

description.zh: 完整 reverse-skill 技能包（85 个 SKILL.md）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：面向逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的技能路由包。
description.en: Complete reverse-skill pack (85 SKILL.md files) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: a skill router for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research.

description.zh: 最懒资深工程师模式（Ponytail）的 DSH 移植：6 个技能（ponytail、ponytail-audit、ponytail-debt、ponytail-gain、ponytail-help、ponytail-review），改编自 DietrichGebert/ponytail（MIT）。
description.en: Ponytail, lazy senior dev mode, for DSH: 6 skills (ponytail, ponytail-audit, ponytail-debt, ponytail-gain, ponytail-help, ponytail-review) adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail (MIT).

description.zh: Matt Pocock 完整发布技能集（25 个 SKILL.md：grilling、writing-for-agents、wait-what、TDD、code-review、wayfinder、ask-matt 路由等）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：改编自 mattpocock/skills（MIT）。
description.en: Matt Pocock's full promoted skill set (25 SKILL.md files: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code-review, wayfinder, ask-matt router and more) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin, adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).

description.zh: Matt Pocock 技能中文版的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：25 个 SKILL.md 正文全译中文（技术术语保留英文并附注释），改编自 mattpocock/skills（MIT）。
description.en: Matt Pocock's skills in Chinese for DSH: all 25 SKILL.md translated to natural Chinese (technical terms kept in English with glosses), adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).

description.zh: DSH skill 经验回流与知识积累元技能：其他 skill 出问题解决后自动回流解决方案并登记知识库（关键词 + 本地 bge 语义双通道检索、7 项写回判断清单、防臃肿归档），附自校验与事件钩子工具。
description.en: Meta-skill for DSH skill experience feedback and knowledge accumulation: feeds fixes back into skills and records a searchable knowledge base (keyword + local bge semantic retrieval, 7-point write-back checklist, anti-bloat archiving), with self-validation and event-hook tools.

description.zh: 文档工坊技能包：纯提示词文档生成——README、PR 描述、changelog 与代码审查。
description.en: Documentation workshop skill pack: pure-prompt doc generation — README, PR description, changelog, code review.

description.zh: Praxis：面向 dsh 的工程方法论技能库（Agent Skills），以 Cordis 插件形式经 ctx.skills 提供。
description.en: Praxis: bundled engineering-methodology skill library (Agent Skills) for dsh, served as a Cordis plugin via ctx.skills.

description.zh: 多区域技能发现、渐进式披露、创建向导、审计与统计。
description.en: Multi-zone skill discovery, progressive disclosure, creation wizard, audit and statistics.

description.zh: keel（龙骨）：规格驱动开发纪律技能包——先立规格、验证假设、防止过度工程与范围蔓延。
description.en: keel (龙骨): spec-driven development discipline skill pack — spec first, verify assumptions, prevent over-engineering.

description.zh: 从现有代码生成 Function、MCP、Agent Skill 和离线测试包，并作为可安装的 DSH Bundle 分发。
description.en: Generates Function, MCP, Agent Skill, and offline test packages from existing code as an installable DSH bundle.

description.zh: 88 个面向研究、社交情报、营销与商业工作流的 Agent Skills，通过原生 DSH bundle 挂载技能目录，也可按项目单独安装 multi-source-search。
description.en: 88 Agent Skills for research, social intelligence, marketing, and business workflows, mounted through a native DSH bundle with optional project-scoped installation of multi-source-search.

description.zh: DSH 技能生命周期管理插件：全局 / 工作区 / 会话三层模型下查看、编辑、导入、启用/停用技能，设置页与对话页统一管理界面，支持跨层全文搜索与分页。
description.en: Skill lifecycle manager for DSH: list / edit / import / enable / disable skills under a global-workspace-session three-layer model, with unified settings & conversation UI, cross-layer search and pagination.

description.zh: Claude Code 风格权限规则引擎：hard/deny/ask/allow 四级规则（hard 高于全访问、不可豁免）、workspace 作用域、通配符路径保护、可视化草稿式编辑器，规则持久化于 settings.yaml。
description.en: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.

description.zh: 用量与消费统计：8/17 调价前后峰谷计费，主界面汇总面板、按会话明细与用量热力图。
description.en: Usage and cost statistics with peak/off-peak pricing after the 2026-08-17 rate change, a main-UI summary panel, per-session breakdowns, and a usage heatmap.

description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Claude Science 式科研工作台：ReAct 研究循环引擎（research_* 工具）、带溯源的版本化工件（artifact_* 工具）与面向基因组/病原体/生物信息的 10 个科研技能。
description.en: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.

description.zh: 搭配一个副模型，每轮被动审查并注入见解。
description.en: Pair a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.

description.zh: 技能驱动的 harness/loop 工程化工作流插件。
description.en: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent plugin.

description.zh: plan/execute 双模型路由：规划模型思考、执行模型干活。
description.en: Dual-model plan/execute routing: a planner model thinks, an executor model acts.

description.zh: 独立只读验收层：顶层 turn 收尾前 spawn 只读 verifier，未通过时把缺口注回主 agent。
description.en: Independent read-only acceptance layer: spawns a read-only verifier before each top-level turn closes and steers non-pass gaps back into the agent.

description.zh: 嵌入式任务管理引擎：决策点协议、念头捕获墙、Linear 形 issue 存储。
description.en: Embedded task management engine: decision-point protocol, idea capture wall, Linear-style issue store.

description.zh: 条件驱动唤醒：file/command/http/process/webhook 持久监视，触发即唤醒 agent。
description.en: Condition-driven wakeup: durable file/command/http/process/webhook watches that wake the agent.

description.zh: Recursive Self-Improvement engine: bounded perceive→integrate→verify→parity→repair→propose loop + 128-plugin 1:1 parity gate — DSH maintains DSH.
description.en: Recursive Self-Improvement engine: bounded perceive→integrate→verify→parity→repair→propose loop + 128-plugin 1:1 parity gate — DSH maintains DSH.

description.zh: 把 UltraCode 式多 Agent 调度带给 DSH：可生成、可保存、可治理、可观察、可恢复的 Workflow 层。
description.en: UltraCode-style multi-agent orchestration: a generatable, savable, governable, observable, resumable workflow layer.

description.zh: 定时 Agent：按 cron 计划运行 prompt，把摘要送到你已有的地方，内置重叠/漏跑/超时安全策略。
description.en: Scheduled agents on a cron: run a prompt on a schedule and get the digest where you already are, with overlap/missed-run/timeout safety defaults.

description.zh: trailmap：磁盘持久化执行规划——里程碑状态机、依赖标注、审计事件与复盘纪要。
description.en: trailmap: disk-persisted execution planning — milestone state machines, dependency tagging, audit events, retrospective notes.

description.zh: 跨会话事件溯源工作台账：任务跟踪、审计历史、看板导出。
description.en: Cross-session event-sourced work ledger: task tracking, audit history, kanban export.

description.zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。
description.en: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.

description.zh: 两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。
description.en: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.

description.zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。
description.en: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.

description.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。
description.en: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.

description.zh: 自适应深度研究编排器（基于官方 workflow 引擎）。
description.en: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator built on the official workflow engine.

description.zh: 发现问题→修复交付→质量复查的对抗式闭环工具集。
description.en: Adversarial checkup → fix → review loop toolset.

description.zh: 面向整个 DSH profile 的治理与路由 bundle，提供可配置的压缩调用与本地作用域语义记忆；兼容 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 与 0.1.0-rc.7。
description.en: Profile-wide DSH governance and routing bundle with configurable compaction calls and scoped local semantic memory; compatible with DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.1.0-rc.7.

description.zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审（grill-requirements 技能 + 工具策略门）。
description.en: Engineering-discipline guard: grill the requirements before the first edit, enforce red/green test evidence gates, and audit the delivery with a forked adversary (grill-requirements skill + tool-policy gates).

description.zh: 官方级 GitHub CI 集成：composite action、轮询 PR 审查机器人（幂等行内评论）、状态检查门，写操作全过审批。
description.en: Production-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action, a polling PR review bot (idempotent inline comments), and a status-check gate; all writes pass through approval.

description.zh: Ollama 本地模型集成：发现/拉取/移除/查看，按任务类型或关键词路由并自动回退云端，/ollama 总览。
description.en: Local Ollama model integration: discover/pull/remove/inspect, route by task type or keyword with automatic cloud fallback, and a /ollama overview.

description.zh: 跨 11 家厂商的参数翻译（temperature/top_p 等）+ 确定性 JSON 修复，绝不编造数据。
description.en: Parameter translation across 11 providers (temperature, top_p, etc.) plus deterministic JSON repair; never fabricates data.

description.zh: 设置页定时任务：支持准点或 DeepSeek 谷时段执行、单次/每日重复，并持久化任务状态。
description.en: Settings-based scheduled tasks that run on time or during DeepSeek off-peak hours, with one-time and daily schedules backed by durable task state.

description.zh: 证据优先、可崩溃恢复的自进化引擎：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件、一次性真实 Loader 准入、Harbor 评估，并保留可审计的日志化谱系。
description.en: Evidence-first, crash-resumable self-evolution engine for DSH: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and an auditable journaled lineage.

description.zh: 定时任务：让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，保留可审计历史。
description.en: Scheduled coding runs in fresh agent sessions with auditable history.

description.zh: 计划批注：选中计划原文逐条批注，结构化反馈送回 Agent。

description.en: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.

description.en: Leaderless flat agent teams: cross-window structured task dispatch (state machine + event stream + offline resume), a read-only progress recorder, and a two-level web dashboard.

description.zh: 原生 Windows toast + 任务栏闪烁，任务完成/审批/提问时触发，支持 Win10/11，npm 安装 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify-win`。
description.en: Native Windows toast + taskbar flash for task done / approval / ask_user_question, Win10/11, npm install `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify-win`.

description.en: Two-way WeChat (iLink) bridge: turn-end and approval-request push, in-chat approve/reject and message injection, persistent dedup and convergent long-reply chunking; channel layer extensible to other IMs.

description.en: ACP bridge between BitFun and DSH.
